from.description: Setup form: joint position in setup space

to.description: Setup form: tip position in setup space

x.description: Local form: x in parent space

y.description: Local form: y in parent space

rotation.description: Local form: rotation in degrees relative to parent

items.description: A bone, in setup form (from/to) or local form (x/y/rotation/length)

and.description: A second switch condition that must hold too

visibleWhen.description: Only show this part while another switch part shows one of these variants

art.description: Art id from `art`, or inline SVG markup (a string starting with '<')

space.description: Coordinate space of the art (default: setup)

and.description: A second switch condition that must hold too

visibleWhen.description: Only show this part while another switch part shows one of these variants

additionalProperties.description: Art id from `art`, or inline SVG markup (a string starting with '<')

variants.description: Variant name → art (use '' for an empty variant)

space.description: Coordinate space of the art (default: setup)

and.description: A second switch condition that must hold too

visibleWhen.description: Only show this part while another switch part shows one of these variants

path.description: SVG path data in setup space

and.description: A second switch condition that must hold too

visibleWhen.description: Only show this part while another switch part shows one of these variants

and.description: A second switch condition that must hold too

visibleWhen.description: Only show this part while another switch part shows one of these variants

oneOf.description: A soft shape stretched over points of the skeleton (the rounded convex hull of circles): a skirt over the waist and the knees, a cape, a belly

and.description: A second switch condition that must hold too

visibleWhen.description: Only show this part while another switch part shows one of these variants

step.description: Grid size of the drawing in character units (default 2)

fill.description: No fill: an occluder (hides the bodies behind it, draws nothing)

shade.description: Colour of the side turned away from the light

blend.description: Smooth union of the shapes over this distance

t.description: Along the 3D bone: 0 = its joint (default), 1 = its tip

at.description: Offset [x, y, z] in body space (rest pose), turned with the bone

to.description: The other end of a cone (none: a sphere)

t.description: Along the 3D bone: 0 = its joint (default), 1 = its tip

at.description: Offset [x, y, z] in body space (rest pose), turned with the bone

box.description: A box of these half sizes [x, y, z] centred on `from`, turned with its bone

items.description: A cone between two points of the skeleton (a sphere without `to`), or a rounded box

oneOf.description: Volumes on the bones of a 2.5D rig (rig3d), drawn each frame from the view: cel shaded, composited per pixel by depth (legs, a lap, a skirt)

and.description: A second switch condition that must hold too

visibleWhen.description: Only show this part while another switch part shows one of these variants

space.description: Coordinate space of the art (default: setup)

turn.description: How much a prop held at this anchor turns with the bone (0 = stays upright, 1 = turns with the hand)

items.description: Capsule along the bone (a circle for zero-length bones) that rigid bodies collide with

part.description: Switch part (mouth variants) or morph part (mouth shapes, smooth blending); a list drives several mouths at once (e.g. one per view)

stride.description: Travel distance per cycle for locomotion clips

prefixItems.description: Easing name or cubic-bezier [x1, y1, x2, y2]. Shapes the segment arriving at this key.

ease.description: Easing name or cubic-bezier [x1, y1, x2, y2]. Shapes the segment arriving at this key.

items.description: [time, value] | [time, value, ease] | { t, v, ease }

tracks.description: Channel path → keyframes sorted by time

rig3d.description: A 2.5D rig: its bones posed in 3D (rotations about the body's sideways axis, plus `turn` and `spread`) and projected for the current view each frame

bones.description: Bones posed in 3D: rest joint and tip in body space (the front view: x right, y down, z towards the viewer)

views.description: Each view of the `view` control → the yaw (degrees) its drawings were made at

pitch.description: How far above the drawings are seen from (degrees, default 0)

chains.description: Limbs drawn in front of or behind the body by their depth

front.description: Part before which a limb nearer than the body is drawn

back.description: Part after which a limb farther than the body is drawn

body.description: Bones whose depth is the body's (default body, neck)
